input.prompt:
sophie is the woman in [Video1].  she wears the blue hospital pajamas in [Image1] and [Image2], and the grippy hospital socks in [Image3], NOT the dress in [Video1]

Dr. Grayson: the doctor in [Video2], [Video3] and [Video4]. the assistant: the woman with the clipboard in [Video2], [Video3] and [Video4].

setting: mental hospital. Dr. Grayson's office — the room in [Video2] and [Video3]. this scene is a continuation of the previous scene in which sophie is on the folding chair as in [Image4], Dr. Grayson in his chair as in [Image5] (they are in the same office)

what came before: sophie and dr grayson were in the middle of a conversation where he was telling her a judge would decide whether she could leave, or would be forced legally to take meds.  

sophie is increasingly panicked, to the point of dissociation  

current scene:  

dr grayson continued:  

"And judging by your performance in class today I’m fairly certain I know what that decision’s going to be.” A malicious grin floats across his face and disappears in an instant.   

a close up on her face, and sophie's eyes go wide, even wider than they were before. then suddenly, her expression is just blank, expressionless.  

she dissociates from her body, and a ghostly version of her is now watching the scene from above, in the corner of the office, right up against the ceiling tiles. even the imaginary version of her isn't able to leave the office.

"You can go now.” says dr grayson. sophie says nothing, still expressionless. she gets up from her chair and walks towards the door of the office, moving as though in a trance. she pulls open the door, turning the doorknob, and her ghostly clone follows her out of the office, still watching from above
